rationale: Saori brings deep materials science expertise from Resonac, a leader in semiconductor and functional materials, while Vinav is actively applying AI and computational methods to materials discovery as a research engineer. They share a core focus on materials science and can exchange perspectives on how AI-driven approaches are transforming traditional materials research—a conversation particularly valuable given Saori's industry experience and Vinav's cutting-edge computational toolkit.
intro_message: Saori Miura, meet Vinav Shah — you both work in materials science from different angles (Saori from Resonac's materials expertise, Vinav from AI applications in materials discovery), and could swap insights on how computation is reshaping the field.
